deadline.value: Application materials for the chemistry PhD are due April 1 for Fall entry, and files are reviewed as they complete.
deadline.quote: all application materials required by the chemistry and biochemistry department must be submitted by April 1st for consideration for the following fall semester

gre_subject.value: The chemistry subject GRE is strongly recommended but not required.
gre_subject.quote: The department strongly recommends test scores from the chemistry subject GRE as well.

gre_general.value: The general GRE is not required but is preferred for chemistry applicants.
gre_general.quote: Submission of test scores from the general GRE exam is not required, but is preferred.

toefl_min.value: The chemistry page gives only old-scale TOEFL scores (550 paper-based or 79 internet-based), so no TOEFL minimum is recorded here; the Graduate School minimum applies.
toefl_min.quote: International students must have a minimum TOEFL score of 550 paper-based, or 79 internet-based, or an overall band score of 6.5 on the IELTS, or a score of 58 on the PTE-Academic.

ielts_min.value: Chemistry states an IELTS overall band of 6.5, the same as the Graduate School minimum.
ielts_min.quote: International students must have a minimum TOEFL score of 550 paper-based, or 79 internet-based, or an overall band score of 6.5 on the IELTS, or a score of 58 on the PTE-Academic.

supervisor.value: Admission does not depend on a named faculty advisor; a research advisor is chosen by the start of the second semester.
supervisor.quote: Students must select a faculty member to be their research advisor by the beginning of their second semester in the graduate program.

funding.value: The chemistry page gives no funding rule; the Graduate School's assistantship range is not a per-student guarantee.
funding.quote: assistantships for 20 hours of work per week for a nine-month period range from $5,800 to $25,000

entry_route.value: The chemistry PhD lists a bachelor's degree in chemistry as the entry requirement, and no master's requirement appears.
entry_route.quote: Baccalaureate degree in chemistry with the following minimum subject requirements

notes: Chemistry catalog: a GPA of at least 3.000 overall and in chemistry, two letters, and a statement of goals. Department web pages are blocked.
name: PhD in Chemistry
